text:
Maya: Morning folks, who broke semver this time? My coffee depends on patch bumps.
Alex: Not me — must be those YAML gremlins. I found `version: 1.0` in prod-config.yml and felt personally attacked.
Sam: Whoever wrote `version: one-dot-oh` earlier deserves a badge. CI just shrugged. :face_with_rolling_eyes:
Jin: New policy idea: every semver sin requires bringing toast for the team. :toast: Ritual enforced.
Maya: Also proposing a YAML exorcism. Quick fix I used: ```sed -n '1,20p' prod-config.yml``` to hunt the offender.
BuildBot: [automated message] build #482 failed: YAML parse error at line 12
Alex: Dumping the offending snippet: ```version: 'v1' # quotes where they do not belong```
Sam: Can we add a pre-commit that normalizes versions? Or replace them all with emojis so future devs can't be wrong 😂
Jin: I'm volunteering to be Toast Keeper if we actually get a toaster wall installed. I'll even craft a plaque: "Semver Sins Begone"
Maya: Quick poll — react :thumbsup: for toaster wall, :rocket: for pre-commit hook. Winner installs the winning solution.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket:
Maya: Tie so far. Tie-breaker: whoever fixes the YAML gets the last slice of toast. Deal?
BuildBot: [automated message] deploy succeeded on retry. Toast Keeper status: pending. :confetti_ball:
